verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability and evaluation platform, so custom code-based scorers are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows plain-English signals that Bento trains into detectors, plus platform-run scoring of releases and nudges. Nothing documents a user-authored, code-based scorer or metric API; natural-language signals and built-in scoring are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
